title: Units of measure R1: the standard unit table in the spec and the organization unit object sys_unit
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
- **U1, U2:** a closed constant in `packages/spec` holding the curated Rec 20 subset, each code with its dimension and its ratio to the dimension's base unit, kept apart from `ValueDomainSchema` the way `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` is. Package codes (`X…`) carry a package dimension and no ratio. Piece is `H87`; `C62` and `EA` are refused.
- **U3:** the system object `sys_unit`, organization-owned (`organization_id` injected, behind the tenant wall like `sys_exchange_rate`), zero shipped rows, org codes in the reserved namespace (at least 4 characters or containing `_`). The seat's U3 notes apply: members can read it, and labels say "unit of measure".
- **L1 / L2 as settled:** the ratio can be edited and the edit affects only later writes (org admin only, audited); code and dimension are immutable after create; delete is allowed; one org-written label per unit (translation is #35404).

## Open items this card carries (settle here, amend the ADR)
- OI1: U1's membership (which codes, dimensions, ratios, package codes).
- OI2: `sys_unit`'s owning package, fields and write grants → #35465.
- OI11: a deleted code created again → #35466.

## Done when
The constant and the object exist with pins (closed set, `H87` admitted, `C62` / `EA` refused, the namespace refusal, tenant isolation, member read, admin-only write); OI1, OI2 and OI11 are answered in ADR-0158. No unit key on fields ships here (U8: the reader comes with the membership card).

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:spec. The first R1 piece; every other R1 card reads these tables.
